purpose: Freeze the complete pre-outcome v0.1 design for a multi-year cross-asset dependence and predictive lead-lag atlas. The task may reason from canonical governance and source semantics only; it may not open market-data bodies, compute correlations/returns, select pairs/lags from outcomes, or launch any execution.

frozen_manager_constraints.physical_source_class: Binance USD-M perpetual public historical completed 1m klines unless later mechanical Shared Historical Backbone qualification proves exact semantic incompatibility
frozen_manager_constraints.exact_resource_binding: RESOURCE_ID/DERIVED_ID are not chosen in this task. Freeze the deterministic source/universe/partition identity rule now; H1-004/shared-backbone qualification may later bind exact IDs mechanically without outcome-driven design changes.
frozen_manager_constraints.base_resolution: 1m completed causal bars for broad atlas
frozen_manager_constraints.broad_network_track: descriptive/calibration and survivor selection only; no direct promotional claim

design_requirements: Freeze an outcome-blind universe rule compatible with one shared Historical Data Backbone and point-in-time instrument membership. Do not select nodes by observed predictive performance, best correlation, best lag, or historical PnL.
Freeze the exact historical cutoff and a deterministic rule for the longest eligible common contiguous span. Do not choose a favorable start date after outcomes.
Freeze development/selection versus untouched chronological holdout and an outcome-blind node/asset holdout or equivalent reserve. Atlas Selection data may never become X1 Confirmation.
Freeze the exact completed-bar causal clock, missingness/gap handling and no-forward-fill rule.

Freeze a small directed lag-profile design. It may use a small predeclared set of lags or lag bands, but it must not authorize unrestricted best-lag mining or post-outcome lag refinement on the same evidence.
Freeze one primary linear dependence/predictive metric and at most one simple robustness metric. Do not add nonlinear methods, transfer entropy, broad Granger grids or ML.
Freeze a causal own-history and market/common-factor control using only past/rolling/expanding parameters. Full-history PCA/beta/factor estimation applied backward is forbidden.
Freeze rolling/time-stability views and the exact search ledger fields so every directed pair/lag/band/regime inspected is recorded.
Freeze Track A with BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT as the only anchors in v0.1. No anchors may be added after outcomes without a new version and fresh evidence.
Freeze Track B broad-network outputs as descriptive/calibration. Any selected relationship is ADAPTIVE_DISCOVERY_GENERATED and requires untouched validation.

Freeze one bounded shock-conditioned propagation design based on a causal leader return shock; optionally one activity/volume-conditioned companion is permitted only if its exact formula and thresholding rule are fixed now. No threshold ladder.

Freeze survivor selection rules that use predeclared stability/incremental-information criteria rather than a p-value leaderboard. Enforce max 4 total survivors, max 2 from broad network and max 2 from anchor track.
Freeze the rule for choosing one actionable horizon per selected relationship before holdout. The holdout may not be used to pick the horizon.

Freeze high-resolution escalation: at most 2 frozen holdout survivors may later move from 1m to 1s/trades, only to test temporal ordering, stale-print/asynchronous-sampling artifacts and actionable lag. This task authorizes no such data access.

Freeze terminal semantics that separate descriptive dependence, predictive incremental support, shock-propagation support, holdout eligibility, and no-survivor/defer states. None is a trading-candidate promotion by itself.
Explicitly preserve C4/C6 and X1-001 terminal conclusions: the atlas is a broader descriptive/predictive research program, not same-evidence rescue of those tested architectures.
forbidden_actions: same-evidence rescue of C4/C6 or X1-001
terminal_rule: Persist exact_result_path first, verify it, refresh/revalidate current main and the exact task, then create/update worker_result_manifest_path LAST as the final repository artifact. After the manifest, write exactly one terminal PR receipt with CONTINUATION_REVIEW_REQUIRED: true and STRATEGY_REVIEW_REQUIRED: true, then stop.
